notes: FY2022 is a full GAAP (accrual/modified accrual) audit with comparative 2021 totals, unlike the later modified-cash reports; basis GAAP. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4); fund balance 1,330,959 -> 793,082. Debt proceeds = bond 510,000 + loan 98,500; bond issue costs (8,905) printed under other financing sources -> other_financing. Transfers in 1,071,590 / out 1,156,363 as printed; the 84,773 difference went to the Sewer Fund (p6, p7 'Transfer of basis to General Fund'). Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash 757,847 + cash with county treasurer 8,269 (p3); beginning cash from the printed 2021 Total column (1,312,675 + 6,903). Business-type from the proprietary statement (p6), measure net position; totals = operating + nonoperating; proprietary cash flows pp7-8. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), lines by activity column. Detail: per fund column of the governmental funds statement (General, Street, Park; p4), the Other Governmental Funds combining statement (Library, Cemetery, CRA; p10) and the proprietary statement (Water, Sewer, Garbage, Keno; p6). The all-funds budgetary schedule (p9) is a combined schedule and is not recorded (would double count). The schedules of county treasurer activity (pp11-12) show collections by the county (tax types) before transfer to the village; not recorded as detail. 'Lease payments' 137,514 is printed as 'Franchise fees' on p2/p9, so categorized occupation/franchise tax. Read pages 1-12 of 12
